title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteDisposalTask
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteDisposalTask. Putting waste in an appropriate facility without the intention of recovery (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.3). Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingTask (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.19).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteDisposalTask'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
